title: Nsure Network (Ethereum) — insurance/underwriting pools; live extractability

Surplus/Treasury/Underwriting/CapitalStake.payouts()/burnOuts() require operator, which is address(0) on all of them (never set); setOperator is onlyOwner (single EOA 0x7023a321...)

CapitalStake.claim()/withdraw() pay only the caller's own accrued rewards / own pending withdrawal; a fresh address has user.amount=0 => 0 NSURE
CapitalStake.deposit() needs nETH, which is no longer mintable (converter bricked); nETH backing was paid out to the team on 2026-10-09 via CapitalConverter.payouts (Safe exec)
Nsure.mint() is minter-gated (3 minters: CapitalStake, ClaimPurchaseMint, 3/5 Safe)
No WETH/NSURE approvals exist from any pool/converter to any spender
